capabilities.name: Create workbook
capabilities.description: Create a new spreadsheet workbook in project storage.

capabilities.name: Open workbook
capabilities.description: Open an existing spreadsheet workbook from project storage.

capabilities.name: Save workbook
capabilities.description: Persist spreadsheet values and structure to project storage.

capabilities.name: Close workbook
capabilities.description: Close the active spreadsheet without closing the project.

capabilities.name: Editable cell grid
capabilities.description: Display and edit spreadsheet cells containing text or numeric values.
capabilities.notes: Current grid supports cell editing and persistence.

capabilities.name: Row and column management
capabilities.description: Add, remove, resize, select, and manage spreadsheet rows and columns.
capabilities.notes: Adding and deleting the last row or column works; full selected-row/column operations and resizing remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Multiple sheets
capabilities.description: Support multiple worksheets inside a workbook.
capabilities.source: PL Spreadsheets / Dev v2 Official v1 Target
capabilities.notes: Current .plsheet.json implementation represents individual sheets rather than a complete multi-sheet workbook model.

capabilities.name: Copy paste and fill operations
capabilities.description: Support cell-range copy, paste, cut, fill, and matrix operations.
capabilities.notes: Matrix copy/paste is explicitly listed as a Sheets v0 limitation.

capabilities.name: Formula engine
capabilities.description: Evaluate formulas and cell references with dependency-aware recalculation.
capabilities.notes: Formulas are explicitly absent from Sheets v0.

capabilities.name: Core function library
capabilities.description: Provide common arithmetic, logical, text, date, lookup, statistical, and aggregation functions.

capabilities.name: Named ranges
capabilities.description: Create and reference named spreadsheet ranges.

capabilities.name: Cell formatting
capabilities.description: Support fonts, colors, alignment, borders, number formats, and other core cell formatting.
capabilities.notes: Cell formatting is explicitly absent from Sheets v0.

capabilities.name: Conditional formatting
capabilities.description: Apply visual formatting based on cell values or formulas.
capabilities.source: PL Spreadsheets / Dev v2 Official v1 Target

capabilities.name: Sorting
capabilities.description: Sort selected spreadsheet data by one or more columns.

capabilities.name: Filtering
capabilities.description: Filter table and range data using user-selected conditions.

capabilities.name: Data validation
capabilities.description: Restrict and validate cell input using configured rules.

capabilities.name: Structured tables
capabilities.description: Convert ranges into structured tables with headers, formatting, sorting, and filtering.
capabilities.source: PL Spreadsheets / Dev v2 Official v1 Target

capabilities.name: Charts
capabilities.description: Create common charts from spreadsheet ranges and tables.
capabilities.notes: Charts are explicitly absent from Sheets v0.

capabilities.name: Basic pivot tables
capabilities.description: Summarize and group tabular data using basic pivot-table workflows.
capabilities.source: PL Spreadsheets / Dev v2 Official v1 Target

capabilities.name: CSV import and export
capabilities.description: Import CSV data and export workbook data to CSV.
capabilities.source: PL Spreadsheets / Common File Import Export
capabilities.notes: CSV import/export is explicitly absent from Sheets v0.

capabilities.name: Common spreadsheet interchange
capabilities.description: Import and export common spreadsheet file formats.
capabilities.source: PL Spreadsheets / Common File Import Export
capabilities.notes: XLSX support is explicitly absent from Sheets v0.

capabilities.name: Printing and PDF
capabilities.description: Provide spreadsheet print layout, print settings, and PDF output.

capabilities.name: Comments
capabilities.description: Attach comments and notes to spreadsheet cells and ranges.
capabilities.source: PL Spreadsheets / Comments and Version History

capabilities.name: Workbook version history
capabilities.description: Maintain recoverable local history for workbook changes.
capabilities.source: PL Spreadsheets / Comments and Version History

capabilities.name: Project-aware data links
capabilities.description: Link spreadsheet cells, ranges, and tables to project assets and shared project data.

capabilities.name: Cross-slice workflows
capabilities.description: Exchange structured data with Docs, Code, Modeling, Animation, and Game Studio.

capabilities.name: AI formula and data assistance
capabilities.description: Provide permissioned AI help for formulas, analysis, explanations, and structured spreadsheet actions.
capabilities.source: PL Spreadsheets / AI Data and Formula Assistance
capabilities.notes: AI actions should remain explicit and user-approved.

capabilities.name: Autosave and recovery
capabilities.description: Automatically preserve workbook changes and recover safely after interruption.

capabilities.name: Medium-to-large workbook performance
capabilities.description: Maintain responsive interaction and calculation performance on normal medium-to-large workbooks.
capabilities.source: PL Spreadsheets / Dev v2 Official v1 Target
capabilities.notes: Requires benchmark fixtures before completion can be claimed.
